content: The Linux Foundation Recommenders documentation supports evaluating top-k ranking with precision, recall, MAP and nDCG and beyond-accuracy behavior with catalog or distributional coverage, novelty, diversity, and serendipity. Academic sources further identify cold start, sparsity, explainability, popularity bias, and reproducibility as distinct concerns. For a controlled TFG, deterministic datasets, splits, seeds, algorithm configuration, timings, and stored outputs are academic requirements rather than ordinary end-user features.
